Standard amortization: For a loan with principal P, interest rate r per period (monthly), number of periods n, the EMI is P * r / (1 - (1+r)^(-n)). The monthly payment is constant. The interest portion of each payment is current balance * r. Principal portion is EMI - interest. Balance updates: balance = balance - principal.
